method: Read-only inspection of original verified jar, javap via jdk.jdeps module, JVM512MiB/CPU1. Original bodies stay local.

findings.fact: LOGIN_SUCCESS sy is sent before exact UUID lookup/deferred admission. DELAY_ACCEPT waits until PlayerList UUID lookup is null before placeNewPlayer.
Same UUID duplicate is disconnected; fresh ServerPlayer and ServerPlayerGameMode are constructed. Removal calls ServerLevel.removePlayerImmediately before removing matching original UUID map entry.
Only connected me.g() connections are ticked; disconnected entries are removed and disconnection is handled, so old listener does not tick its mining manager after retirement.
Marks old entity removed and removes it from entity map/chunk. World tick skips removed entities.
Checks original listener connection me.g() before dispatch; queued packets for disconnected original profile are ignored.
UUID is four big-endian i32 words (16 bytes), followed by name. Saved original packet UUID matches independently named playerdata file.

conclusion: Common legacy recovery must await fresh play JOIN/position plus received site/player/inventory and ground admission. LOGIN_SUCCESS alone is insufficient. No old-session release or history transfer.
legacy_regression: common_profile_recovery_cancelled_login_keeps_shared_claim: matching LOGIN_SUCCESS without new JOIN/position stays pending; cancelled admission closes fresh socket and retains shared source claim
